methodology.http: Read-only GETs to the route union from live indexes, frozen local content, 67 known redirect rules, and seven locally mapped planned cluster slugs. Four concurrent workers, 10-second connect/35-second read timeouts, eight-MiB response bound, six-hop same-host redirect limit, 0.15-second worker pause. HTTP and static HTML meta-refresh redirects recorded separately. No failed requests were observed.
methodology.local_rendering: Frozen local MDX metadata loaded with pipeline/article_metadata.py; article and dossier authored prose rendered using the production contentEvidencePipeline.ts with explicit empty finding evidence maps and support spans disabled. This compares prose independently of live database or citation resolution. The rendering process did not read the live database.
methodology.prose_selection: Articles: article .prose. Dossiers: .prose blocks representing lead and section body text; section headings, system-role subtitle, sidebar metadata, open questions, references, navigation, raw findings, visualizations, and generated support details are outside this prose comparison. Separately compared H1 titles, dossier section headings, system-role subtitle, and string-valued open questions; all comparable values match. methodology.normalization: Parse HTML, decode public Cloudflare data-cfemail text as the browser does; remove generated citation superscripts, generated citation-block references, script/style/template elements and data-viz markers; retain authored link labels and prose/table/list text; preserve inline text adjacency; add separators at block boundaries; Unicode NFKC and collapse whitespace. Case and punctuation retained. Matching hashes prove equality only under this documented normalization. One dossier (Steven Pesner) differs strictly, but matches after an explicitly recorded EFTA document-label exclusion; it is labeled citation_rendering_only instead of a prose edit. methodology.finding_text: For dossier All Findings cards, compare sorted multiset of rendered summary/detail pairs against frozen dossier finding summary/detail pairs after whitespace and Unicode normalization. Finding IDs, type, confidence, review status, evidence references/quotes, dates, profile ownership, links and order are not compared. Duplicate text pairs retain multiplicity.
